Plot simulated replicates against reference values

plot_calibration_replicates.Rd

One box of per-replicate values (calibration_box_stats(): quartiles and median, whiskers at whiskers, the replicates beyond them as dots), with each reference beside it in a column of its own, labelled with its value and its replicate_percentile() among the replicates. Dashed lines at the whiskers' ends run across the panel, so each reference reads against them.

Usage

plot_calibration_replicates(
  values,
  references = NULL,
  whiskers = c(0.05, 0.95),
  label = NULL,
  name = "Simulated"
)

Arguments

values

Numeric, one value per replicate.

references

Optional data frame with name and value, one row per reference value (a recorded value, a target), in the order to draw them.

whiskers

See calibration_box_stats().

label

Optional function turning a value into its label text; the default prints three significant figures. Units are the caller's.

name

The label of the replicates' column.

Value

A ggplot object with no title or axis titles.

Details

Whether the whiskers are an acceptance range or only a spread is the caller's to say: a calibration that scores pooled statistics, not replicates, should say the box is a spread.

See also

Other calibration plots: calibration_box_stats(), calibration_events(), calibration_plot_palette(), plot_calibration_area_by_fuel(), plot_calibration_convergence(), plot_calibration_fire_counts(), plot_calibration_fire_sizes(), plot_calibration_groups(), plot_calibration_loss(), plot_calibration_severity(), plot_calibration_severity_by_size(), plot_fire_regime_multipliers(), replicate_percentile()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  plot_calibration_replicates(
    c(3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 20, 26, 39),
    data.frame(name = c("Record", "Target"), value = c(15.3, 13.5))
  )
}
